basic_details.job_title: IISER Bhopal Institute Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal) has announced 1 vacancy for the Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF) post on a contract basis under advertisement number IISERB/DoFA/2026/31. The engagement is initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on satisfactory performance. Candidates holding a PhD in life sciences or a related area can apply. The notified pay is Rs. 67,000 per month + HRA, while candidates awaiting PhD award receive Rs. 35,000 per month + HRA until degree submission. Eligible applicants can apply by email by

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure-I) from the official institute resources.
Prepare a latest Curriculum Vitae (CV), a comprehensive list of publications, and a detailed research plan for one year (maximum two pages).
Attach a scanned copy of the PhD Degree certificate or PhD Thesis submission receipt.
Send the completed application form in PDF format along with all required documents via email to [email protected].
Ensure the email is sent on or before 22 October 2026.
Mention the exact subject line: "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Biological Sciences)".

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal
Non-coding RNAs in infection, inflammation and disease (Prof. Himanshu Kumar)
Initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year
Rs. 67,000/- per month + House Rent Allowance (Rs. 35,000/- per month + HRA for thesis-submitted candidates awaiting degree)
Preference will be given to candidates below 35 years of age as on the last date of submission

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed for the position. Essential Qualification: PhD in life sciences or a related area; at least one first-author research publication; hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology. Ph.D. scholars after submission of thesis are also eligible to apply, provided they submit the provisional or degree certificate within 6 months from the date of appointment. Desirable Qualification: Experience in non-coding RNA biology; RNA isolation and expression analysis; qRT-PCR; RNA-seq or small-RNA-seq data analysis; miRNA/lncRNA/circRNA target prediction; RNA-RNA or RNA-protein interaction assays; reporter assays; gene knockdown or overexpression.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected fellow will receive a fellowship of Rs. 67,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance as per Institute rules. Candidates who have submitted their thesis and are awaiting the award of the PhD degree or provisional degree will be paid a reduced fellowship of Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA until the degree is submitted, after which the full fellowship is restored effective from the award date. Accommodation is not provided by the Institute. IPDFs are required to maintain a mandatory medical insurance policy of a minimum of Rs. 1 lakh throughout the fellowship period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (IPDF)
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure-I) from the official institute resources. Prepare a latest Curriculum Vitae (CV), a comprehensive list of publications, and a detailed research plan for one year (maximum two pages). Attach a scanned copy of the PhD Degree certificate or PhD Thesis submission receipt. Send the completed application form in PDF format along with all required documents via email to [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent on or before 22 October 2026. Mention the exact subject line: "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Biological Sciences)".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be processed by the institute, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not entitle any candidate to be called for an interview. Besides research work, the selected fellow is expected to assist in teaching courses as required by the Department.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is initially for one year with the possibility of extension for another year based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance (HRA) is paid in addition to the monthly fellowship as per Institute rules. No accommodation is provided by the Institute.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age preference?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates below 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of the application.

faq.question: Q4. What subject line must be written in the application email?
faq.answer: Applicants must mention the subject line exactly as: "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Biological Sciences)".

faq.question: Q5. What are the desirable qualifications for this project?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include experience in non-coding RNA biology, RNA isolation and expression analysis, qRT-PCR, RNA-seq data analysis, target prediction, interaction assays, reporter assays, and gene knockdown or overexpression.
